info.name: SelfStorage Pro - Real API Flows
info.description: Postman collection for real Spring Boot API flows. Mock payment is server-side only. Run backend first.

item.name: 00 - Authentication
item.description: Run all login requests first. Tokens are stored automatically in environment.

request.description: Login as Customer. Update username/password variables if seed data differs.
Login as Staff. Update username/password variables if seed data differs.
Login as Facility Manager. Update username/password variables if seed data differs.
Login as Operations Manager. Update username/password variables if seed data differs.
Login as System Admin. Update username/password variables if seed data differs.

item.name: 01 - Public search
item.description: No login required for these read endpoints.

item.name: 02 - Flow 1 Customer reservation and deposit
item.description: Run in order. Use returned reservationId and backend-calculated amount.

request.description: Creates reservation and deposit invoice. Save reservationId from response.
Server-side mock payment. Amount must match deposit invoice.
Bank information used by VietQR UI.
Empty until handover; populated after staff handover.

item.name: 03 - Flow 5 Manager assignment and staff dispatch
item.description: Choose real unitCode/staffId from previous responses before PATCH/POST.

request.description: Assign an available unit from Managed units response. Replace unitCode.

item.name: 04 - Flow 2, 3 and checkout
item.description: Run after Flow 1 and unit assignment. Set pinCode from customer contract response.

request.description: Requires reservation RESERVED and assigned unit.
Requires deposit + first rent paid. Saves contractId.
Customer sees active contract and PIN.
Use pinCode returned by My contracts.
Requires checkout request. Backend calculates cleaning/lock deductions.

item.name: 05 - Flow 7 Support ticket and incidents
item.description: Run after an active contract exists.

request.description: Requires active rented contract and unitCode.
